'''Ganner One''' was [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] designation in [[Second Galactic Civil War]] during [[Battle of Corellia (Second Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Corellia]]. He served there as a part of the informal [[Ganner Squadron]]. Wedge later passed this designation to [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]].
